publication: Planck 2018 results. I. Overview and the cosmological legacy of Planck
transcription_policy: All five rows needed for the four-component comparison are retained with their reported 68-percent uncertainties. Baryon and cold-dark fractions are obtained only after outward interval propagation through the complete Hubble row; no central-value-only conversion is used.
